notes.title: Allison's Diary: Rebirth - Localized Worldwide!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

we released a new 1.4 build, which makes Rebirth now fully available in the following languages:

- English
- Italian
- French
- German
- Spanish
- Portuguese
- Russian
- Chinese
- Arabic

KR Games team

notes.title: Version 1.3 - Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for your support and constructive critic, since it really helps to work on improvements and fixes that make the whole experience as great as possible.

The new 1.3 update is live and it brings with it:
 - run / boost light fix: now it is possible to run at every moment
 - controller fix: R1 instead of button X to boost light (much easier for gamepad 
   users to kill enemies while moving the camera)
 - difficulty fix (it is still possible to select the difficulty level from the settings)
 - new animations
 - lights and audio improvements

Please continue to post your bug reports and feedback in the discussions area of the Community Hub or via our [url=http://www.krgames.it/en]web site[/url].
